messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 41 13 storefront glazing system at the entry vestibule are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? No rush on this -- please respond when convenient. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. A response within three days would be appreciated.
